mechanism: Isotretinoin causes hyperlipidemia and can impair renal function; bumetanide as a loop diuretic may exacerbate electrolyte disturbances and dehydration, increasing risk of acute kidney injury and hyperuricemia.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and lipid panel regularly; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative acne therapy if possible or use lowest effective bumetanide dose with close clinical monitoring.
